'''Echo Station 3-7''' was a scout post near [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. During the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], [[Rebel trooper/Legends|Rebel soldiers]] were under orders to hold out as long as possible, then hurry to the evacuation zone once they'd retreated past Station 3-7.
